description:
We're transforming the grocery industry

At Instacart, we invite the world to share love through food because we believe everyone should have access to the food they love and more time to enjoy it together. Where others see a simple need for grocery delivery, we see exciting complexity and endless opportunity to serve the varied needs of our community. We work to deliver an essential service that customers rely on to get their groceries and household goods, while also offering safe and flexible earnings opportunities to Instacart Personal Shoppers.

Instacart has become a lifeline for millions of people, and we’re building the team to help push our shopping cart forward. If you’re ready to do the best work of your life, come join our table.

Instacart is a Flex First team

There’s no one-size fits all approach to how we do our best work. Our employees have the flexibility to choose where they do their best work—whether it’s from home, an office, or your favorite coffee shop—while staying connected and building community through regular in-person events. Learn more about our flexible approach to where we work.

Overview

We're hiring a Senior Software Engineer II to be the backend lead for Instacart's Pricing & Incentives team. The team is a mix of ML and backend engineers building the systems behind shopper pay and incentives. We use ML to make real-time, financially critical, compliance-sensitive decisions that keep shopper pay fair, protect contribution profit, and keep orders on time. We also own Shopper Incentives (getting shoppers online in the right place at the right time), Shopper Acquisition, and Tip Recommendations.

The team drives roughly a third of the company's annual contribution profit goal, so your work will show up directly in business results.

About the Job

  • Serve as the backend lead for the pricing system, a financially critical platform where correctness and reliability matter
  • Design, build, and operate scalable backend systems that power real-time pricing, shopper pay, and incentive decisions
  • Build and improve ML infrastructure in close partnership with ML engineers, data scientists, and product managers
  • Proactively identify gaps in system design, reliability, and correctness, and drive them to resolution
  • Own systems end to end, from design and development through testing, deployment, and operations
  • Grow into the go-to expert on the pricing stack, with a clear path toward Staff Engineer

About You

Minimum Qualifications

  • 5+ years of professional software engineering experience, including experience at the senior level
  • Experience building and operating scalable, production backend systems
  • Experience owning financially critical or high-stakes systems where correctness matters
  • A track record of driving business outcomes, not just shipping code

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience working closely with ML engineers or on ML infrastructure
  • Experience building real-time systems
  • Experience in pricing, payments, marketplace, or other financially sensitive domains

#LI-Remote

Instacart provides highly market-competitive compensation and benefits in each location where our employees work. This role is remote and the base pay range for a successful candidate is dependent on their permanent work location. Please review our Flex First remote work policy here.

Offers may vary based on many factors, such as candidate experience and skills required for the role. Additionally, this role is eligible for a new hire equity grant as well as annual refresh grants. Please read more about our benefits offerings here.

For US based candidates, the base pay ranges for a successful candidate are listed below.

CA, NY, CT, NJ
$230,000—$242,500 USD
WA
$220,000—$232,000 USD
OR, DE, ME, MA, MD, NH, RI, VT, DC, PA, VA, CO, TX, IL, HI
$211,000—$222,500 USD
All other states
$192,000—$202,500 USD
